NATIONAL ASSEMBLY (EXEMPTION FROM PREVENTIVE DETENTION AND PERSONAL APPEARANCE)

An Act to amend
the Members of the National Assembly
(Exemption from
Preventive Detention and Personal
Appearance) Ordinance,
1963
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 11th February, 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 11th February 1975, and
is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title.-----This
Act may be called the Members of the National Assembly (Exemption from
Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) (Amendment) Act, 1975.

Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance IX of 1963

ACT XVII OF 1975
ACT XVII OF 1975
MEMBERS OF THE
NATIONAL ASSEMBLY (EXEMPTION FROM PREVENTIVE DETENTION AND PERSONAL APPEARANCE)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act to amend
the Members of the National Assembly
(Exemption from
Preventive Detention and Personal
Appearance) Ordinance,
1963
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 11th February, 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 11th February 1975, and
is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 3 of Ordinance
IX of 1963.-----In the Members of the National Assembly (Exemption from
Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Ordinance, 1963, in section 3,
for subsection (2) the following shall be substituted and shall be deemed to
have been so substituted on the eighth day of February 1975, namely :-
"(2) Nothing in subsection
(1) shall be construed as applying to any Member who is detained under any such
law as is referred to in sub section (1)-
(a) at any time during the period
commencing on the fifteenth day next after the conclusion of a session and
ending on the 15th day before the commencement of the next session, or
(b) for reasons of State
connected with defence, external affairs, or the security of Pakistan or any
part thereof.".
